Birinyi Associates Inc increased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 7.11% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 60,281 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $6.89 million, up from 56,281 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Birinyi Associates Inc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $826.95B market cap company. The stock increased 1.50% or $1.59 during the last trading session, reaching $107.71. About 37.43M shares traded.
